help.usage:
rootcause - hands-on IT troubleshooting practice

Play:
  init                 Start Postgres, run migrations, create the local profile
  next                 Start the recommended next exercise
  start <exercise-id>  Start a specific exercise
  ticket               Show the active ticket again
  shell                Open a shell in the active sandbox
  hint                 Reveal the next hint
  check                Grade the active session
  reset                Fresh copy of the same problem
  giveup               End the session and show the walkthrough (after hint 3)
  status               Active session, topic levels, review queue and best stars
  list                 All exercises with best stars
  stats [--refresh]    Statistics per exercise (--refresh rebuilds them first)
  lang en|no           Set the interface language

Developer:
  validate <dir>              Validate an exercise definition
  vars --seed <n> <dir>       Print a seed's variant values
  selftest --seed <n> <dir>   Prove an exercise end to end in real sandboxes
error.no_root: Cannot find the RootCause folder. Run rootcause from inside the repo, or set RC_ROOT to its path.
error.no_env: Cannot read deploy/compose/.env. Copy deploy/compose/.env.example to deploy/compose/.env and set a password, or set RC_DATABASE_URL.
error.env_incomplete: deploy/compose/.env must set POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_DB and POSTGRES_PASSWORD.
error.compose_failed: Could not start Postgres with Docker Compose.
error.postgres_unhealthy: Postgres did not become ready within 60 seconds. See why with: docker logs rootcause-postgres-1
error.db_unreachable: Postgres started, but rootcause cannot connect to it on 127.0.0.1:5432.
error.no_docker: Cannot find the docker command. Install Docker Engine first.
error.no_shell: This kind of sandbox cannot open a shell here.
error.needs_init: Cannot reach the database. Run: rootcause init
error.not_isolated: Docker maps sandbox root to host root. Enable userns-remap or rootless Docker first (see OQ-3 in docs/SPEC.md).
error.cgroup_v2_required: This exercise needs a host with cgroup v2 (the WSL2 default), and Docker reports cgroup v1 here. Choose another exercise, or switch the host to cgroup v2.
next.weakest: Next: {exercise}, from your weakest topic ({topic}, level {level}).
next.review: Review: {exercise} is back, as a new variant.
next.fallback: Your statistics are not up to date, so this pick uses your topic levels only, without the review queue.
next.none: There is no other exercise to pick right now. Start one with: rootcause start <exercise-id>
